lines.text: After seven months, the priests and diviners tell the Philistines to send the ark back with five gold tumors and five gold rats.
The Philistines prepare a new cart with two milk cows, pen up their calves, and watch whether it goes toward Shiloh.
The cows go straight to Beth-shemesh, and the people chop up the cart and offer the cows as a burnt offering.
The five rulers return to Gath that same day, after the Philistines sent one gold tumor for each city.
God strikes down seventy men who looked inside the ark, and the men of Kiriath-jearim take it into Abinadab's house.
